'''Vladimír Palko''' (born 20 May 1957 in [[Čuňovo]]) is a [[Slovakia|Slovak]] politician. He is a member of the [[National Council of the Slovak Republic]] and former [[interior minister]] of [[Slovakia]].<ref>[http://www-8.vlada.gov.sk/index.php?ID=1272 Vladimír Palko, Úrad vlády SR]</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.kdsonline.sk/index.php?q=100&id=2 |title=Konzervatívni demokrati Slovenska, ľudia |access-date=2009-03-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090225065107/http://www.kdsonline.sk/index.php?q=100&id=2 |archive-date=2009-02-25 |url-status=dead }}</ref> On 12 March 2008 he established a new party called [[Conservative Democrats of Slovakia]] after he left [[Christian Democratic Movement]] in February 2008, due to his skepticism and disappointment about leadership of [[Pavol Hrušovský]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Palko založil stranu konzervatívnych demokratov |url=http://hnonline.sk/slovensko/c1-23236760-palko-zalozil-stranu-konzervativnych-demokratov |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110720181431/http://hnonline.sk/slovensko/c1-23236760-palko-zalozil-stranu-konzervativnych-demokratov |archive-date=2011-07-20 |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=hnonline.sk}}</ref> This political party was dissolved in 2014.<ref name="Kern">{{Cite web |last=Kern |first=Miro |date=2015-01-09 |title=Palkova strana KDS potichu zanikla |url=https://dennikn.sk/19461/palkova-strana-kds-potichu-zanikla/ |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=Denník N |language=sk-SK}}</ref>

He is married and has three children.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=a.s |first=Petit Press |title=ŽIVOTOPIS: Vladimír Palko |url=https://www.sme.sk/domov/c/zivotopis-vladimir-palko |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=SME.sk |language=sk}}</ref> His son Vladimír Jr. is a historian who has worked at the [[National Memory Institute (Slovakia)|National Memory Institute]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Vladimír Palko ml. |url=https://www.postoj.sk/autor/vladimir-palko-ml |access-date=2025-12-16 |website=Konzervatívny denník Postoj |language=sk}}</ref> Another son, Andrej, is an actor<ref>{{Cite web |title=Andrej Palko {{!}} Biografia |url=https://www.csfd.sk/tvorca/62961-andrej-palko/biografia/ |access-date=2025-12-16 |website=ČSFD.sk |language=sk-SK}}</ref> and a member of the Drama Ensemble of the State Theatre Košice.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Andrej Palko {{!}} Národné divadlo Košice |url=https://www.sdke.sk/sk/andrej-palko |access-date=2025-12-16 |website=www.sdke.sk}}</ref> He also has a daughter, Viera.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sudor |first=Karol |date=2019-11-20 |title=Vladimír Palko: Ak je niekto muž, je pre mňa mužom, hoci sa cíti byť ženou. Držím sa objektívnej reality (ukážka z novej knihy) |url=https://dennikn.sk/1658257/vladimir-palko-ak-je-niekto-muz-je-pre-mna-muzom-hoci-sa-citi-byt-zenou-drzim-sa-objektivnej-reality-ukazka-z-novej-knihy/ |access-date=2025-12-16 |website=Denník N |language=sk-SK}}</ref>

== Early career ==
In 1981, Vladimír Palko graduated from the [[Comenius University Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics|Faculty of Mathematics and Physics of Comenius University]] in Bratislava, and in 1987 he obtained the degree of Candidate of Sciences. Between 1981 and 1990, he worked as an assistant professor at the Department of Mathematics at the Faculty of Electrical Engineering of the [[Slovak University of Technology in Bratislava|Slovak University of Technology]] in Bratislava, and as a researcher at the Institute of Technical Cybernetics of the [[Slovak Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=":0" />

From 1991 to 1996, he served as an assistant professor at the Department of Mathematics of the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Information Technology of the [[Slovak University of Technology]]. He obtained the academic title of Associate Professor (Docent) in mathematics in 1996.<ref name=":0" />

== Political career ==
From 1991 to 1992, he served as Deputy Director of the Federal Security Information Service.<ref name=":0" />

=== Christian Democratic Movement ===
Vladimír Palko has been a founding member of the [[Christian Democratic Movement]] (KDH)<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Štandard - Vladimír Palko |url=https://standard.sk/author/vladimir-palko |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=Štandard - Vladimír Palko |language=sk}}</ref> in 1989.

From November 1996 to July 1998, he was active in KDH as vice-chairman of the party. In July 1998, he became a member of the [[Slovak Democratic Coalition]] (SDK) and was elected as a Member of the [[National Council of Slovakia|National Council]].<ref name=":1" />

He renewed his membership in KDH on 15 January 1999. in April he became KDH Vice-Chairman for Press and External Relations and he was reconfirmed in this position several times. In the 2002 parliamentary elections, he was elected as a Member of Parliament for KDH.<ref name=":1" />

In July 2006, after ten years, he resigned from his position in the KDH presidium. This step was a reaction to his disagreement with the election of the chair of the KDH parliamentary group following the parliamentary elections. At that time, at a party congress in Senec, KDH voted in favor of possible coalition cooperation with [[SMER]], which Vladimír Palko and others opposed.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Palko |first=Vladimír |date=2008-03-02 |title=Čo sa stalo v KDH |url=https://www.tyzden.sk/casopis/1821/co-sa-stalo-v-kdh/ |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=.týždeň - iný pohľad na spoločnosť |language=sk}}</ref> SMER, however, subsequently formed a coalition with [[People's Party – Movement for a Democratic Slovakia|HZDS]] and [[Slovak National Party|SNS]] and KDH moved into opposition.<ref>{{Cite web |last=a.s |first=Petit Press |title=Smer, SNS a HZDS zostavili kabinet pred necelými 16 mesiacmi |url=https://www.sme.sk/domov/c/smer-sns-a-hzds-zostavili-kabinet-pred-necelymi-16-mesiacmi |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=SME.sk |language=sk}}</ref>

In June 2007, Vladimír Palko ran for chairman of KDH but the congress confirmed [[Pavol Hrušovský]] in a secret ballot.<ref>{{Cite web |last=a.s |first=Petit Press |title=Hrušovský: KDH nie je v kríze, aj keď to nie je ideálne |url=https://www.sme.sk/domov/c/hrusovsky-kdh-nie-je-v-krize-aj-ked-to-nie-je-idealne |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=SME.sk |language=sk}}</ref>

Ultimately, on 21 February 2008, he left the party, together with [[František Mikloško]], [[Pavol Minárik]], and [[Rudolf Bauer (politician)|Rudolf Bauer]], with the intention of founding a new political party.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2010-03-01 |title=Palkovci nejdú do volieb |url=https://spravy.pravda.sk/domace/clanok/165491-palkovci-nejdu-do-volieb/ |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=Pravda.sk |language=sk-SK}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=a.s |first=Petit Press |title=Hlasy nespokojných voličov chce nová Palkova strana |url=https://www.sme.sk/domov/c/hlasy-nespokojnych-volicov-chce-nova-palkova-strana |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=SME.sk |language=sk}}</ref>

=== Conservative Democrats of Slovakia ===
The new political party [[Conservative Democrats of Slovakia]] (KDS) was registered with the Ministry of the Interior on 22 July 2008 and Vladimír Palko became its first chairman.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Register politických strán a politických hnutí |url=https://ives.minv.sk/rez/registre/pages/detailps.aspx?id=153176 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240617153648/https://ives.minv.sk/rez/registre/pages/detailps.aspx?id=153176 |archive-date=2024-06-17 |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=ives.minv.sk}}</ref>

In the 2009 European Parliament elections he was the lead candidate on the KDS–[[Civic Conservative Party (Slovakia)|OKS]] coalition list.<ref>{{Cite web |last=a.s |first=Petit Press |title=Kandidáti pre voľby do Európskeho parlamentu |url=https://www.sme.sk/domov/c/kandidati-pre-volby-do-europskeho-parlamentu |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=SME.sk |language=sk}}</ref> This coalition also signed a cooperation agreement with [[Declan Ganley]]’s pan-European Eurosceptic movement [[Libertas.eu|Libertas]] in Bratislava on 15 May 2009. Libertas supported the KDS–OKS candidates in the elections to the [[2009 European Parliament election|European Parliament]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=2009-05-15 |title=KDS-OKS sa spojilo s Libertas |url=https://euractiv.sk/section/europa-dnes/news/kds-oks-sa-spojilo-s-libertas-012827/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210124055819/https://euractiv.sk/section/europa-dnes/news/kds-oks-sa-spojilo-s-libertas-012827/ |archive-date=2021-01-24 |access-date=2025-12-14 |work=euractiv.sk |language=sk-SK |url-status=live }}</ref>

However, the coalition received only 2.1% of the vote and won no seats. KDS did not contest the 2010 parliamentary elections, citing the party’s financial problems.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Konzervatívni Demokrati Slovenska |url=http://www.kdsonline.sk/index.php?q=200&m_id=1&id=640 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714205904/http://www.kdsonline.sk/index.php?q=200&m_id=1&id=640 |archive-date=2014-07-14 |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=www.kdsonline.sk}}</ref> In 2014, the party was dissolved following Rudolf Bauer’s failure in the Košice mayoral elections.<ref name="Kern"/>

=== Post-Political Career ===
After leaving politics, Palko has been primarily engaged in writing and journalism.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sudor |first=Karol |date=2019-11-20 |title=Vladimír Palko: Ak je niekto muž, je pre mňa mužom, hoci sa cíti byť ženou. Držím sa objektívnej reality (ukážka z novej knihy) |url=https://dennikn.sk/1658257/vladimir-palko-ak-je-niekto-muz-je-pre-mna-muzom-hoci-sa-citi-byt-zenou-drzim-sa-objektivnej-reality-ukazka-z-novej-knihy/ |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=Denník N |language=sk-SK}}</ref>

From 2010 to 2020, he contributed to the conservative magazine Postoj<ref>{{Cite web |title=Vladimír Palko |url=https://www.postoj.sk/autor/vladimir-palko |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=Konzervatívny denník Postoj |language=sk}}</ref> and from 2021, until his departure in 2025, he was an commentator at Štandard magazine.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Organizácia |url=https://firma.standard.sk/organizacia/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220930011530/https://firma.standard.sk/organizacia/ |archive-date=2022-09-30 |access-date=2025-12-14 |work=Denník Štandard |language=sk-SK}}</ref> In 2025, together with former editors of Štandard, he co-founded the media outlet Marker, where he works as a commentator.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Marker.sk |title=Vladimír Palko - Komentátor |url=https://marker.sk/autori/9/vladimir |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=Marker.sk |language=sk}}</ref>
